_comment: A full cube of Create's own andesite casing, plus a plate carrying the trough. The casing is referenced, never copied -- the sprite lives in Create's jar and is resolved at runtime, which is also what lets CWConnectedTextures shift it to the connected sheet so a bank of these has no seams. What is ours is the trough on top and the food and gauges CanteenRenderer draws over it. The trough is a plate a whisker proud of the top face rather than part of the sheet, because a face baked with a trough in it cannot connect; PLATE in CanteenRenderer is the same number and check_canteen_grid holds the two together. Every face of the cube spans the block boundary, so every face culls; the plate does not cull, because a Canteen under glass should still show what is in it.

elements.__comment: The block itself. One texture on all six faces, the way a casing is.
The trough, over the panel and clear of the face by PLATE.
